Shape the Future of Financial Services with Capco

 At Capco, we specialize in management consulting and software development, partnering with leading international banks and insurance companies across Western Europe. Our innovative approach and collaborative culture make us the ideal place for professionals looking to make an impact in financial services technology.

 Want to learn more about our culture and people? Visit us: Capco Careers Slovakia 

 
 Why Join Us? 

 
 Prestigious Clients & Exciting Projects – Work with top-tier banks on transformation projects that redefine financial services.

 Continuous Learning & Development – Access to technical and soft skills training, professional certifications, and full access to the Udemy online learning platform.

 Flexible Work Environment – we provide flexibility to work remotely from the home office

 Attractive Benefits Package:
✅ Private health care & paid sick days
✅ 25 vacation days (regardless of age)
✅ Monthly cafeteria allowance (€50/month) or contribution to the 3rd pillar
✅ Fully paid meal vouchers
✅ Multisport card with employer contribution
✅ Smartphone with 1TB data + Laptop

 Well-being & Community Engagement – Join yoga lessons, mental health webinars, running challenges, sports activities, or participate in our volunteering days.

 Long-term career – Permanent employment contract with opportunities for career growth.

 The minimum gross monthly base salary for this position is from  € 2,500 . The final offer could be higher to reflect the candidate’s experience, skills, and overall fit for the role. Additionally, this position may also be eligible to receive a discretionary/variable bonus payment. Capco is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation to our people. Our compensation policies are designed to allow our people to progress through our defined salary range over time as they progress in their role.

 
 
 

 Role Description 

 As a Data Engineer, you will build and operate pipelines for your client's data platform in a regulated financial services environment. You will connect priority sources to the Azure Databricks Bronze layer, transform data into your client Enterprise Data Model / Silver layer and prepare data for APIs, Power BI, analytics and AI. You will work with architects, business teams and governance functions to deliver transparent, high-quality and reusable solutions.

 
 You support agile delivery of data-engineering solutions from functional requirements and source analysis through development, testing, deployment and operational handover

 You implement ingestion and onboarding of priority data sources into the Azure Databricks (Bronze layer) and build transformations into your client Enterprise Data Model (Silver layer)

 You implement source-to-target mappings, business rules and use-case-specific pre- and post-processing while maintaining efficient, traceable and reusable pipelines

 You apply data-quality, metadata and lineage requirements and work with Okta access-management and Microsoft Purview data-governance controls as part of platform delivery

 You support the lifecycle of data products and their consumption through APIs / MCP interfaces, Power BI and other approved use cases, including defect resolution and operational support

 
 
 Skills and Expertise 

 
 You have a successfully completed university degree, for example in computer science, business information systems, engineering, natural sciences or a comparable discipline

 You have practical experience developing data pipelines and data-platform solutions, ideally in regulated financial services, banking or asset-management environments

 You bring at least three years of relevant development experience with SQL and good Python skills, together with hands-on experience in data transformation and integration

 You have hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and data-lake / data-warehouse concepts, including Bronze / Silver processing and enterprise data models

 You understand APIs and MCP interfaces and can work with data-governance requirements covering access controls, Microsoft Purview data-loss prevention, metadata, lineage and data quality

 You have experience analysing legacy or heterogeneous source data, translating business rules into technical transformations and supporting reusable data products for reporting, analytics or AI;

 Fluency English (German is a big advantage)

 
 
 Your Hiring Journey 

 ✅ Screening Call – Introductory chat with our recruiter
✅ Technical Interviews (1-2 rounds, depending on the project ) – Discuss your skills with our experienced Capco colleagues
✅ Feedback & Offer – Receive an offer to join our team!

 
 Why Capco? Because You Matter.

 At Capco, we prioritize your career growth and well-being. You will have a personal coach to support your development and a flat hierarchy that encourages you to share and implement your ideas. Plus, our team events, sports activities, and networking opportunities help you stay connected and engaged beyond work.

 Curious to learn more? Apply now – it only takes 5 minutes!

 📩 Contact: Zora Paulikova – zora.paulikova@capco.com 
💻 Connect on LinkedIn: Zora Paulikova | LinkedIn
